headline: PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto Zardari on Saturday laid the foundation stone of a new 600-bed hospital in Larkana that will provide modern medical facilities to Larkana and adjacent areas, APP reports.

card.desc: Jadeed tibbi sahooliyat ek hi chhat tale milengi

caption:
Larkana mein 600-bed ka naya hospital banega!
APP ke mutabiq PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto Zardari ne Saturday ko Larkana mein 600-bed hospital ka sang-e-bunyad rakha. Is hospital mein Larkana aur aas paas ke ilaqon ke logon ko specialised ilaj aur jadeed tibbi sahooliyat ek hi chhat tale milengi.
Aap ke ilaqe mein kis sahoolat ki sab se zyada zaroorat hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
